events.text:
I couldn't take any of the screenshots, because the preflight check still prints NOT READY. It ran under `/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/bin/python3`, the interpreter T-351 names.

- **What failed:** Accessibility is still off for Python, and the Mac's screen was locked.
- **What works:** Screen Recording is on, and the Claude window is found (id 6880).

Where each item stands:

| Item | State |
|---|---|
| `prep` | Done: demo folders are ready in `/tmp/e-demo` |
| `preflight` prints READY | Failed: it printed NOT READY for the two reasons above |
| Create the temporary weekly routine | Not done. Accessibility is off, so the agent can't click or type in the Claude app |
| Capture the 5 slots and fill `shots[]` | Not done for the same reason |
| Delete the routine and log it in `REVERT_LEDGER.md` | Nothing to do: no routine was created, so nothing needs reverting |
| check-guides capture-needed drops by 5 | Not met. I didn't get a new count this run (the check printed only a permission hint), but no captures were added |
| Commit and push | Nothing to commit. I made no file changes, so I didn't push |
| T-351 | Reopened as blocked, with the failed checks and the interpreter in its note, as the Orchestrator asked |
| T-132 | Set to blocked, no new ask added. Note F-b25a034c acknowledged |

To unblock it, Adi needs to do two things at the Mac:
1. Switch on Python 3.12 under System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility (add it with + if it isn't listed).
2. Leave the Mac unlocked with the Claude app open.

When `python3 app/scripts/shots/claude-app-shots.py preflight` prints READY, the next run can take all 5 screenshots with no other input.
